name: Bit-adaptive LSQ + noise warmup
tagline: LSQ scales initialized at a bit-aware fraction of |W|_max with a noise-mix warmup, plus an annealed outlier hinge and an in-grid attraction term.

key_hyperparams.name: clip_ratio (init)
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of max|W| used for initial scale

key_hyperparams.name: warmup_frac (noise-mix)
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of training spent ramping fake-quant in

key_hyperparams.name: g_scale boost
key_hyperparams.role: amplifies LSQ scale gradient at low bits

init_recovers: Plain LSQ at noise_mix=1, no aux_loss, clip_ratio=1.
diff_from_baseline: Layered on top of LSQ: bit-aware scale init (clip_ratio<1 at low bits), a fake-quant noise-mix warmup that fades from FP toward LSQ, and two bit-conditioned regularizers (outlier hinge + post-warmup grid attraction).

name: LSQ + warmup-step noise ratio
tagline: Standard LSQ where the fake-quant grid is linearly mixed with the FP weight over the first warmup_steps then fully applied.
diff_from_baseline: Identical to the LSQ baseline except the fake-quant residual (ŵ − W) is multiplied by a linearly-ramping noise ratio for the first warmup_steps so training begins close to FP.

name: RTN-anchored LSQ + lattice align
tagline: LSQ with log-scale parameter blended toward the deployment RTN scale, with a late-stage center-masked round-error penalty.

key_hyperparams.name: center mask threshold
key_hyperparams.role: skip clipped-out values from align loss

key_hyperparams.name: scale_reg weight
key_hyperparams.role: anchors learned scale to RTN scale

init_recovers: RTN finetune-then-PTQ when α=0; pure LSQ when α=1 with no align loss.
diff_from_baseline: LSQ where the train-time scale is blended toward the actual deployment (max-abs RTN) scale on a cosine schedule, plus an aux loss that pulls non-clipped weights to integer lattice points and pins log-LSQ near RTN — closing the train/eval grid mismatch.

name: LSQ + scale-anchor regularizer
tagline: Plain LSQ plus a tiny ramped MSE between the learned scale and its max-abs initialization to prevent drift.

key_hyperparams.name: schedule
key_hyperparams.role: linear ramp from 0.5 to 1 over training

diff_from_baseline: Adds a single scale-anchoring penalty mean(((s − s_init)/s_init)²) at coefficient 1e-4, ramped linearly from 0.5 to 1; otherwise identical to the LSQ baseline.

name: LSQ + per-group rounding offset
tagline: LSQ with a per-group learnable rounding offset δ that fades in over 100 steps, plus grid-MSE and δ L2 aux losses.

key_hyperparams.name: grid_loss_weight
key_hyperparams.role: weight on grid-MSE in aux loss

key_hyperparams.name: delta_reg_weight
key_hyperparams.role: L2 weight on per-group offset δ

key_hyperparams.name: clip_grad
key_hyperparams.role: clamp on scale and delta gradients

key_hyperparams.name: ema_momentum
key_hyperparams.role: EMA on scale (used in aux loss)

init_recovers: Plain LSQ when δ=0 and warmup_t=1.
diff_from_baseline: Extends LSQ with a per-group learnable rounding offset δ that ramps in over the first 100 steps, plus an auxiliary loss that combines a grid-MSE pulling W toward integer points and an L2 on δ — a learned-rounding variant in the spirit of AdaRound applied at QAT time.
